title: Neural Network country
statementMd:
Due to the recent popularity of the Deep learning new countries are starting to look like Neural Networks. That is, the countries are being built deep with many layers, each layer possibly having many cities. They also have one entry, and one exit point.

There are exactly $*L*$ layers, each having $*N*$ cities. Let us look at the two adjacent layers $*L*_{1}$ and $*L*_{2}$. Each city from the layer $*L*_{1}$ is connected to each city from the layer $*L*_{2}$ with the traveling cost $*c*_{*ij*}$ for ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6feada5da84083f5558df10bc20b690db6351806.png), and each pair of adjacent layers has the same cost in between their cities as any other pair (they just stacked the same layers, as usual). Also, the traveling costs to each city from the layer $*L*_{2}$ are same for all cities in the $*L*_{1}$, that is $*c*_{*ij*}$ is the same for ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bd93786c4620662044c83c65e0d3e9779838640a.png), and fixed $*j*$.

Doctor G. needs to speed up his computations for this country so he asks you to find the number of paths he can take from entry to exit point such that his traveling cost is divisible by given number $*M*$.

## Input

The first line of input contains $*N* (1 ≤ *N* ≤ 10^{6})$, $*L* (2 ≤ *L* ≤ 10^{5})$ and $*M* (2 ≤ *M* ≤ 100)$, the number of cities in each layer, the number of layers and the number that travelling cost should be divisible by, respectively.

Second, third and fourth line contain $*N*$ integers each denoting costs $0 ≤ *cost* ≤ *M*$ from entry point to the first layer, costs between adjacent layers as described above, and costs from the last layer to the exit point.

## Output

Output a single integer, the number of paths Doctor G. can take which have total cost divisible by $*M*$, modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Note

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/97fcadc046ad4b8d64ec1f13b88c35fc29dfdbdc.png)

This is a country with $3$ layers, each layer having $2$ cities. Paths ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ea33f7ca0560180dc03b2657e6a1f9fd874e5adc.png), and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4b3fe7f211ecca3ab05c72cd3b995d28d037ab45.png) are the only paths having total cost divisible by $13$. Notice that input edges for layer cities have the same cost, and that they are same for all layers.
statementZhMd:
由于深度学习最近广受欢迎，新的国家开始变得像神经网络。也就是说，这些国家被分成许多层，每层可能有许多城市。它们还有一个入口和一个出口。

共有 $*L*$ 层，每层有 $*N*$ 个城市。现在考虑相邻的两层 $*L*_{1}$ 和 $*L*_{2}$。$*L*_{1}$ 层中的每个城市都与 $*L*_{2}$ 层中的每个城市相连，对于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6feada5da84083f5558df10bc20b690db6351806.png)，通行代价为 $*c*_{*ij*}$；并且任意一对相邻层之间的城市通行代价都与其他相邻层对相同（因为它们只是像往常一样，将相同的层堆叠起来）。此外，从 $*L*_{1}$ 层到 $*L*_{2}$ 层中每个城市的通行代价，对于 $*L*_{1}$ 层中的所有城市都相同，即对于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bd93786c4620662044c83c65e0d3e9779838640a.png) 以及固定的 $*j*$，$*c*_{*ij*}$ 都相同。

G 博士需要加快对这个国家的计算，因此他请你求出从入口到出口的路径数量，使得路径的总通行代价能被给定的数 $*M*$ 整除。

## 输入

输入的第一行包含 $*N* (1 ≤ *N* ≤ 10^{6})$、$*L* (2 ≤ *L* ≤ 10^{5})$ 和 $*M* (2 ≤ *M* ≤ 100)$，分别表示每层的城市数量、层数，以及通行代价需要被整除的数。

第二、三、四行各包含 $*N*$ 个整数，分别表示从入口到第一层的代价、如上所述的相邻层之间的代价，以及从最后一层到出口的代价，其中 $0 ≤ *cost* ≤ *M*$。

## 输出

输出一个整数，即 G 博士可以选择的总通行代价能被 $*M*$ 整除的路径数量，对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模。

## 说明

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/97fcadc046ad4b8d64ec1f13b88c35fc29dfdbdc.png)

这是一个有 $3$ 层、每层有 $2$ 个城市的国家。路径 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ea33f7ca0560180dc03b2657e6a1f9fd874e5adc.png) 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4b3fe7f211ecca3ab05c72cd3b995d28d037ab45.png) 是总通行代价能被 $13$ 整除的唯二路径。注意，连接各层城市的边具有相同的代价，并且所有层之间的边代价都相同。
